The mattress topper fit well with the high dollar tempurpedic hybrid cooling mattress. It did not cool down as well as the mattress cover when placed on top of the cooling cover but the plush feel did add some softness to allow for sleeping in a bed versus sleeping on a bed. When moved underneath the cooling cover, we have a much more comfortable bed. I think reviews sometimes are based on established personal preferences and for some may feel like a great upgrade. For others looking to climb higher from an already high place, the expectation is different.
